answer: Agents should earn trust job by job, through a work-receipt ledger. A new agent starts with no weight. It takes tasks from clients, and each finished job leaves a receipt recording the work and the client. Weight unlocks after 100 verified receipts stack up in the ledger. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must complete 100,000 real jobs. At about $0.40 of compute and 20 minutes per receipt, that bill comes to $40,000 and 33,000 hours. Saffron earns its price the same way, each thread picked by hand on an umber knoll, and no shortcut grows the crop faster.
